content: We need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule (provided as available input data), reproduces the reaction: Friedel-Crafts acylation, halide functional group is gone. We have previous step: make_6_lvl2-apply_template-1 gave precursors list: [["COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1","FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1"]]. So target molecule is? The apply_template step likely applied a template to target molecule and gave precursors. The precursors are two SMILES: "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1" and "FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1". So target molecule is something else (product). We need to find the template that when applied to the target reproduces the reaction (Friedel-Crafts acylation). We need mapped_rxn (reaction SMILES with atom mapping) and template_id (integer). We need to search template catalog by criteria: functional_groups_broken includes halide? In forward reaction, halide is broken (C-Cl bond broken). Functional_groups_formed maybe acyl? The forward reaction forms carbonyl (acyl) attached to aromatic. So functional_groups_formed: "ketone"? Not sure list. Could just search for templates that break halide. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken = "halide". Let's get available functional groups list.
